questions.question: What is the only valid direct child element of <ul> and <ol> in HTML5?
questions.explanation: According to the HTML standard, only <li> elements (and script-supporting elements) can be direct children of <ul> and <ol>.

questions.question: Which attribute creates an ordered list that counts down from 5 to 1?
questions.explanation: The boolean attribute 'reversed' specifies that the items of the ordered list are in reverse order.

questions.question: In a description list (<dl>), which tag defines the term being described?
questions.explanation: <dt> defines the description term, while <dd> provides the description details/data.

questions.question: Which list type is semantically ideal for a cooking recipe's chronological preparation steps?
questions.explanation: <ol> (ordered list) is the semantic element for steps where chronological sequence is essential.

questions.question: How do you create Roman numeral numbering (I, II, III) on an <ol>?
questions.explanation: The type="I" attribute formats the list markers as uppercase Roman numerals.
